author: NASA

description: Composite "true color" multispectral satellite image of Enewetak Atoll, Marshall Islands. NASA Landsat 7 ETM+ bands used were 3 (red), 2 (green), 1 (blue), and the image was pan-sharpened to 15m resolution. Imagery courtesy of NASA/USGS.
